scope: Existing85 files only: BP repetition/history/physical trajectories, fixed25 DO episode content, actual final-batch exposure and explanatory linkage
weighting: Mean of two futures within parent, then equal mean of five parents; N16 fixed physical cases
initial_BP_risk_sets: 74/6 unique parent-case success/failure, duplicated over two futures as148/12 run-case histories per arm; verify from raw labels
history_timing: Only four observed policy evaluation outcomes. No interpolation of exact ability-loss/recovery time
acquisition_opportunities: First success16k/32k/64k leaves2/1/0 subsequent scheduled evaluations; never label64k acquisition as demonstrated retention
physical_time: x0 actual reset; T_t selects action before state, physical sample x_t after action; t1..500; control_dt .0125s
BP_source_metric: abs(button world Y-goal Y), official success<=.02m; original current-state flag; verify every stored transition
DO_x0: Fixed85 physical mapping: q0=raw_reset_handleY-goalY-.19; h0=goal+[0,.19+q0,0]; raw reset obs and x1 retained separately; never modify SAC arrays
DO_windows: Exactly frozen50 windows (25 episodes x2); no new detector, cutoff or window reselection
DO_opening: p_t=-q_t in metres, raw joint retained; net=sum positive increments - sum negative increments, include transition at window start
DO_aftermath: e+1 through first sigma inclusive, not a reused training window. End-anchored drawdown=max(0,p_e-min(post)); additional opening=max(post)-p_e. Full endpoint net gain reversal only when window net>1e-8 and later p<=p_(a-1)+1e-8
gripper: Fourth normalized command and measured physical width are separate; no inferred open/close functionality label
contact: Control endpoint only; reconstruct body-identified robot-object geom pairs from saved offsets and schema, not all substeps
unknown_pre_tcp: No reset TCP inferred from a different observation point; first-link motion unavailable if pre-step physics absent. All selected DO windows are checked for pre-TCP availability
exposure: Within parent/future/arm take nonnegative checkpoint cumulative actor/critic actual-use differences. Match source episode+window offset and permanent transition ID; never native draw count
linkage: At16k use only0-16k; at32k use intervals ending<=32k; at64k ending<=64k. Show interval and cumulative exposure with paired BP changes and other-task tradeoffs
relationship_summaries: Descriptive tables/scatters only; no significance search, fitted predictor or causal per-episode attribution. Report within-parent future reversals and near-identical exposure as competing explanation
uncertainty: Reuse original85 pre-existing BP AUC/final parent-bootstrap summaries only. No new draws or p-values
illustrations: For each of P-U/P-B final case type choose median case-AUC difference with parent/future/case tie-break; include reference-only and identical histories; video availability never changes numeric selection
publication: Not authorized by this analysis request
